text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First day of summer training camp. Shinko 
Windy is fawned over and pampered by the 
surrounding Umamusume, who acknowledge her 
great achievements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In high spirits, Shinko Windy aimed to 
become the strongest during this training 
camp so the whole world would fawn over 
her.
